name: EXIF完整性验证
description: Validates EXIF data structure 完整性 by checking mandatory camera fields, field consistency, version compliance, and 元数据 completeness. 检测 异常 in EXIF data that indicate AI generation or post-processing 篡改.
mechanism:
The EXIF 完整性 validator examines:

1. **Mandatory Field Presence**: 检查 for essential camera EXIF fields (Make, Model, ExifVersion, DateTimeOriginal, FocalLength, ExposureTime, FNumber, ISO). Genuine camera images contain most of these fields.

2. **Field Value Consistency**: Cross-validates related fields — e.g., DateTimeOriginal should precede DateTimeDigitized; ExifVersion should match known standards.

3. **Structure Completeness**: 计算 an 完整性 ratio based on how many mandatory fields are present vs expected. High ratio indicates authentic camera capture.

4. **Version Compliance**: Validates ExifVersion against known JEITA standards (0220-0232).
parameters:
必需相机字段: Make, Model, ExifVersion, DateTimeOriginal, FocalLength, ExposureTime, FNumber, ISOSpeedRatings
EXIF版本: 0220, 0221, 0230, 0231, 0232
accuracy: 高 - 80-90% 准确度 for images with intact EXIF data. Less effective when 元数据 has been stripped.
useCase: Second-pass 元数据 validation: verifies EXIF structural 完整性 after initial 元数据 scan 以识别 subtle 篡改 or fabrication. Essential for 取证 workflows requiring comprehensive 元数据 authentication.
strengths:
• 全面的多字段验证检测AI不一致性
• 相关字段间交叉验证提供高置信度
• 适用于所有JPEG和TIFF格式
• 低计算开销——即时结果
• 同时检测AI生成和元数据伪造
limitations:
• EXIF完全被删除时无法产生结果（不确定）
• 某些应用为隐私目的故意删除EXIF
• AI工具正在改进生成逼真EXIF数据
• 社交媒体平台删除大部分EXIF字段
• 无法验证手动伪造的EXIF

references.title: JEITA CP-3451C — Exchangeable Image File Format (Exif) Version 2.32
Farid, H. (2019). Image Forensics. Annual Review of Vision Science.
Kee, E., et al. (2011). Digital image authentication from JPEG headers. IEEE TIFS.
